notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for the official IEEE 1516.1 ordinary directed-interaction surface. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies directed publication, by-ownership and universal subscription, directed send targeting, delivery callbacks, invalid-handle failures, and pre-connect/pre-join service boundaries without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador directed publication, subscription, and send services with FederateAmbassador directed-delivery callbacks
